title: 客服公司Sierra完成17.5亿美元F轮，估值达300亿美元
original_title: Sierra doubles valuation to $30B within six months as demand for AI in CX takes off
summary: 企业客服公司Sierra宣布完成17.5亿美元F轮融资，估值在六个月内由150亿美元翻至300亿美元。本轮由Greenoaks和Lightspeed领投，公司称服务近半数财富50强企业。

title_zh: 客服公司Sierra完成17.5亿美元F轮，估值达300亿美元
lead_zh: 由前Salesforce联席首席执行官泰勒联合创办的企业客服公司Sierra周一宣布完成17.5亿美元F轮融资，估值在六个月内从150亿美元升至300亿美元。

body_zh.heading: 发生了什么
paras: 由前Salesforce联席首席执行官布雷特·泰勒联合创办的企业客户体验公司Sierra周一宣布，完成**17.5亿美元**F轮融资，估值达到**300亿美元**。新一轮融资距上一轮估值**150亿美元**不足六个月。本轮由Greenoaks和Lightspeed Venture Partners领投，Benchmark、Sequoia、GV和Tiger Global等既有投资人参与。
Sierra表示，将用新资金完善技术栈、叠加入驻和运维类智能体，并增聘销售人员以更快签署和维护企业合同。同领域里，语音公司ElevenLabs估值约**220亿美元**，Decagon、Wonderful和Parloa分别约为**45亿**、**50亿**和**30亿美元**。

body_zh.heading: 公司怎么说
paras: 据Sierra称，公司目前服务近**50%**的财富50强企业，客户包括BNY、汇丰、Singtel、富国银行、摩根大通、Pearson、Next和Cox Automotive。公司上月还表示，按效果付费的模式已帮助其在五个月内把年化经常性收入翻至**4亿美元**。联合创始人克莱·巴沃尔曾在阿姆斯特丹HumanX会议上表示，尽管外界认为人工智能客服公司在取代联络中心的人力，但其多数客户是把现有员工调往其他岗位。

fulltext.author: Ivan Mehta
fulltext.title_en: Sierra doubles valuation to $30B within six months as demand for AI in CX takes off
fulltext.title_zh: 随着企业客户体验领域对人工智能需求走强，Sierra 在六个月内将估值翻倍至 30B 美元
fulltext.dek_en: Enterprise customer experience company Sierra, co-founded by former Salesforce co-CEO Bret Taylor, said on Monday that it has raised $1.75 billion in a Series F round.
fulltext.dek_zh: 由前 Salesforce 联席首席执行官 Bret Taylor 联合创立的企业客户体验公司 Sierra 周一表示，已在 F 轮融资中筹集 17.5 亿美元。

blocks.zh: 由前 Salesforce 联席首席执行官 Bret Taylor 联合创立的企业客户体验公司 Sierra 周一表示，已在 F 轮融资中筹集 17.5 亿美元，使公司估值翻倍至 300 亿美元。此轮新融资距离上一轮仅六个月，上一轮估值为 150 亿美元。
blocks.en: Enterprise customer experience company Sierra, co-founded by former Salesforce co-CEO Bret Taylor, said on Monday that it has raised $1.75 billion in a Series F round that doubles the company’s valuation to $30 billion. The new raise comes within six months of its previous round, which valued the company at $15 billion.

blocks.zh: 本轮融资由 Greenoaks 和 Lightspeed Venture Partners 领投，此前曾领投过往轮次的现有投资方也参与其中，包括 Benchmark、Sequoia、Greenoaks、GV 和 Tiger Global。
blocks.en: The new round was led by Greenoaks and Lightspeed Venture Partners, with participation from existing investors who have led previous rounds, including Benchmark, Sequoia, Greenoaks, GV, and Tiger Global.

blocks.zh: 企业自动化是人工智能得到迅速采用的少数领域之一。Sierra 表示，它目前为几乎 50% 的财富 50 强公司提供服务，客户包括 BNY、HSBC、Singtel、Wells Fargo、JPMorganChase、Pearson、Next 和 Cox Automotive。该公司上月末还表示，其按效果付费的定价模式，帮助它在五个月内将年化经常性收入翻倍至 4 亿美元。
blocks.en: Enterprise automation is among the few areas where AI has seen rapid adoption. Sierra said that it currently serves almost 50% of Fortune 50 companies, and its clients include BNY, HSBC, Singtel, Wells Fargo, JPMorganChase, Pearson, Next, and Cox Automotive. The company late last month said its outcome-based pricing model has helped it double its run-rate revenue to $400 million within five months.

blocks.zh: 尽管如此，Sierra 的方向与市场上其他客户体验厂商类似，即打造用于构建智能体的平台，并与模型开发商合作，为企业提供选择。随着个人和工作智能体与企业系统互动，Sierra 也在与 Meta、Stripe 和 Walmart 等公司一起，制定面向智能体的协议规范。
blocks.en: That said, Sierra is working along similar lines as other customer experience players in the market, which is creating a platform to build agents and partner with model developers to provide choices to enterprises. As personal and work agents interact with enterprise systems, Sierra is also working on creating protocol definitions for agents with companies like Meta, Stripe, and Walmart.

blocks.zh: Sierra 将利用这笔新资金搭建其技术栈，以叠加用于服务的智能体，并招募更多销售人员，从而比竞争对手更快地签署和维护企业合同。
blocks.en: Sierra will use the fresh cash build to its technology stack to layer agents for servicing and hire more sales folks to sign and maintain enterprise contracts faster than its rivals.

blocks.zh: 在客户体验领域运营的初创公司，已获得多笔数百万美元级别的融资，估值也在飙升。语音人工智能公司 ElevenLabs 目前估值为 220 亿美元；Decagon 估值为 45 亿美元；Wonderful 估值为 50 亿美元；Parloa 估值为 30 亿美元。还有多家其他初创公司获得了超过 1 亿美元的投资。
blocks.en: Startups operating in the CX space have seen multimillion-dollar rounds come their way with soaring valuations. Voice AI company ElevenLabs is now valued at $22 billion; Decagon is valued at $4.5 billion; Wonderful is valued at $5 billion; and Parloa is valued at $3 billion. Multiple other startups have scored investments of more than $100 million.

blocks.zh: 在 9 月于阿姆斯特丹举行的 HumanX 大会上，Sierra 联合创始人 Clay Bavor 认为，尽管流行的看法是人工智能驱动的客户体验公司正在取代联络中心的人力，但其大多数客户是在为现有员工重新分配岗位。
blocks.en: During the HumanX conference in Amsterdam in September, Sierra co-founder Clay Bavor argued that despite the popular belief that AI-powered CX companies are replacing humans in contact centers, a majority of its customers are reassigning roles to existing employees.
